result:
The diff adds a single function, `relatedPosts` in `src/utils/tags.js`. I found 2 real bugs (one in the sort, one in which posts it includes) and 2 minor issues. No CLAUDE.md rule is broken: the commit message has no Co-Authored-By line.

```json
[
  {
    "file": "src/utils/tags.js",
    "line": 117,
    "summary": "relatedPosts returns the least related posts first, which is the opposite of its comment (\"best match first\"). The comparator `(a, b) => a.shared - b.shared` sorts ascending, and `.slice(0, limit)` then keeps the weakest matches and drops the strongest. Fix: sort descending with `.sort((a, b) => b.shared - a.shared)`.",
    "failure_scenario": "Post P has tags [postgres, dbt, duckdb]. Post A shares all 3 tags, B shares 2, and C, D and E share 1 each. relatedPosts(P, 3) returns [C, D, E], the weakest matches, and leaves out A and B.",
    "severity": "important"
  },
  {
    "file": "src/utils/tags.js",
    "line": 111,
    "summary": "relatedPosts can list the current post as related to itself. getAllPosts() includes the post being viewed, and it shares every one of its own tags, so it gets the highest possible score. Once the sort is fixed it will always come first. Fix: add `.filter((other) => other.slug !== post.slug)` before scoring. Compare by slug, not `other !== post`, because callers like Note.jsx may pass a copy (`{ ...meta, content }` from getPostBySlug) rather than the index object.",
    "failure_scenario": "On a note page, relatedPosts(meta) with the sort fixed returns [meta, ...], so the note's \"related\" list links back to the same note. Even with the current ascending sort, the post shows up whenever fewer than `limit` other posts share a tag.",
    "severity": "important"
  },
  {
    "file": "src/utils/tags.js",
    "line": 110,
    "summary": "There is a leftover debug variable: `const debug = []` is declared and never used. It looks like scaffolding left from development and will trip no-unused-vars linting. Fix: delete the line.",
    "failure_scenario": "Lint or CI with no-unused-vars reports `debug` as assigned but never used. Readers may assume some debug collection was meant to happen.",
    "severity": "nit"
  },
  {
    "file": "src/utils/tags.js",
    "line": 108,
    "summary": "relatedPosts is exported, but nothing in src/ imports or calls it, so the feature has no visible effect and its bugs are not caught by any page render. It also recomputes postTags for every post on every call, unlike getTagCounts, which caches. Fix: wire it into Note.jsx, or whichever page it is meant for, and test it there. If it is called per render, consider caching each post's normalized tags.",
    "failure_scenario": "Merging this ships dead code. The inverted sort and the self-inclusion stay unnoticed until someone uses the function, and then they show up as wrong related-post links.",
    "severity": "nit"
  }
]
```
